_meta.disclaimer: Illustrative, simplified summary of central government schemes for a hackathon demo. Criteria and amounts change; always confirm on the official portal before applying.

schemes.name: PM-KISAN
schemes.benefit: Income support of Rs 6,000 per year in three instalments, paid to the bank account.

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
schemes.benefit: Health cover of up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year for hospitalisation at empanelled hospitals.
documents: Ration card or proof of eligibility

schemes.name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
schemes.benefit: LPG connection without deposit for women from eligible poor households.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Housing for All)
schemes.benefit: Financial assistance / interest subsidy towards a pucca house for eligible households.

schemes.name: Atal Pension Yojana
schemes.benefit: Guaranteed monthly pension of Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000 after age 60, based on contribution.

schemes.name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
schemes.benefit: Renewable life cover of Rs 2 lakh for a low annual premium auto-debited from the bank account.
documents: Savings bank account with auto-debit consent

schemes.name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana
schemes.benefit: Accident insurance cover of Rs 2 lakh for a very low annual premium.
documents: Savings bank account with auto-debit consent

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
schemes.benefit: Small-savings account for a girl child with a government-notified interest rate and tax benefits.
documents: Parent / guardian ID and address proof

schemes.name: National Scholarship Portal (central scholarships)
schemes.benefit: Central scholarships for students; eligibility and amounts vary by scheme and category.

schemes.name: PM MUDRA Yojana
schemes.benefit: Collateral-free loans for small businesses under the Shishu, Kishor and Tarun categories.

schemes.name: Stand-Up India
schemes.benefit: Bank loans for setting up a new enterprise, for women and SC/ST entrepreneurs.

schemes.name: PM Kaushal Vikas Yojana (skill training)
schemes.benefit: Short-term skill training with assessment and certification.

schemes.name: PM Jan Dhan Yojana
schemes.benefit: Zero-balance basic savings account with RuPay debit card and built-in accident cover.
documents: Aadhaar or other officially valid document
